items.content: The longtime executive won't be leaving Apple just yet but staff at the company say it's a step closer to Schiller retiring.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage drags on, but things are improving

items.title: Chevron Expansion in Venezuela Extends U.S. Influence Over Oil Riches
items.content: The U.S. energy giant, which stayed in the country after other Western companies left, will invest $7 billion in the country to more than double its production there.

items.title: Investors Still on Edge Over War, Debt and Inflation
items.content: U.S. and Iranian forces traded attacks again, pushing oil prices higher, stocks lower and making bond investors nervous.

items.title: Employer Health Costs Are Expected to Spike in 2027
items.content: A new U.S. survey anticipates an average increase of 11 percent unless benefits are cut, the highest rate in decades. Other findings also predict a sharp rise.

items.title: Global Bond Rates Are Rising. What Should You Do Now?
items.content: If you own bonds, they may be in a broad fund that hasn’t lost much money. And that fund may do much better in the next several years.
